items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: I knew of a years ago. That's the 101 they called it... Lee Collins played there.

ctx.x: He had his, his daddy was a preacher. I think he come from, uh, he was born in, uh, what's the name of that place again? Memphis. That's where he come from. And he went back to Memphis and he died. That's the last job they played when, which, uh, Lee Collins. Oh, yes. Lee Collins played there. I knew of a years ago. That's the 101 they called it, but it was, uh, and they called it the Entertainer. And they called it the 101.
Did you play there with, uh, that group ever?
